body:
Thank you for this issue.

I confirmed this on the online demo.

Surely, `ArrayBindingPattern` allows trailing comma ([spec](https://tc39.github.io/ecma262/2016/#prod-ArrayBindingPattern)).
Acorn seems to throw this syntax error only in the parameters of arrow functions. Acorn is parsing trailing comma of `ArrayBindingPattern` in other places validly.
@michaelficarra Do you have any insights?

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/1937871/14223195/215693e0-f8b6-11e5-84d3-66960ce1a584.png)
